snippet.title: Gravity Bumpers — Early Access Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gravity Bumpers is a free, open-source game currently in Early Access! In this video, I'm sharing some raw gameplay footage of my first-ever game project.

Game source code can be found on my GitHub (link is available on my main channel page)

This video is licensed under Creative Commons (CC BY). You are completely free to use this gameplay footage in your reviews, previews, compilations, or gaming news. Just drop a link to this channel in your description. Thank you!

Any contributions, feedback, or bug reports are highly appreciated. Let me know what you think in the comments!

#GravityBumpers #opensourcegame  #indiedev  #gameplay  #freegame  #gamedev
